sources.title: Advisor Fees
sources.scope: Automatic Billing, Blended Fee, fee notices, and pending configuration notes; public HTML verified in the approved sector research.
supported_claims: The vendor describes annualized net-liquidation-value fees and blended fees with separate value ranges and rates.
The vendor notes that configuration requests pending client authorization are not in effect.
The vendor describes fee notices identifying calculation method, amount, and period.
sources.limitations: Vendor-specific process context only. Synthetic approval is not client consent. No invoice submission, debit, compliance determination, or reproduction of IBKR billing is implemented.

sources.title: Automatic Billing Methods and Examples
sources.scope: Percent of Net Liquidation Value and Flat Fee examples; public HTML verified in the approved sector research.
supported_claims: The vendor's annualized-percentage daily example uses a 252-business-day divisor.
Its flat-fee example also states a 252-day allocation convention.
sources.limitations: This supports making the calculation basis explicit, not our invented 365/366 calendar-day agreement policy. Flat fees and performance fees are excluded. No regulatory content is inferred.
